exchanges.interviewer: What takes most of your day?
exchanges.reply: I type every PDF invoice into Procountor by hand, it takes about three hours a day.
Invoices over 2,000 euros wait for the department head, sometimes six working days.
Half of the orders come by email and I retype each one into the TMS, five to eight minutes per order.
Customers call all day asking where their shipment is.
Luen yövuoron paperisen vuoronvaihtolomakkeen, ja käsiala on usein lukukelvotonta.
